summary: Advance to researcher. Hypothesis revised to match available descriptive evidence; strict token-budget comparisons are unfeasible. Task: Inspect 4 sources on general memory performance trends.
body: The previous plan failed because no sources provide empirical data comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets. Forcing this would violate the bounded research protocol. We must now revise the hypothesis to match available evidence: identify 4 sources describing general agent memory performance (e.g., retrieval accuracy, context retention) without strict resource constraints. This yields descriptive findings, not causal superiority claims. Limit to 4 sources to ensure feasibility within the remaining review window. Do not implement code.
